title: AI Agent vs Chatbot Explained
topic: What is an AI agent and how is it different from a chatbot?
hook: Think AI chatbots are impressive? AI agents are about to render them obsolete.
script: Think AI chatbots are impressive? AI agents are about to render them obsolete. While a normal chatbot just gives you answers based on text prompts, it can't actually do things for you. An AI agent goes a step further. It can reason, set goals, make decisions, and use external tools. Instead of just telling you flight prices, an agent can search, book the flight, and update your calendar automatically. This turns AI from a simple talking assistant into an autonomous digital worker. Want to keep up with the future of tech? Follow Streamovate for quick explainers every day!
